lines.text:
I’m the chairman of the Pokémon Fan Club!
I raise more than a hundred Pokémon!\c
I’m very fussy when it comes to Pokémon!
I surely am!\c
So...\c
Did you come visit to hear about
my Pokémon?

Oh!\c
You see, my favorite, Rapidash, is the cutest!
It’s SO cute and lovely and smart... It’s almost
too much to take!\c
Plus, it’s really amazing when you stop to
look at it. Don’t you think so?\c
Oh yes. Its looks are so stunning, and its heart
is so kind... You can’t help but love it!\c
And when you hug it tight when it’s sleeping—
it’s so warm and cuddly...\c
Plus, it looks spectacular, of course.
Oh, and it’s simply ravishing when—
Oops! Look at the time!
I kept you too long!\c
Thanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pikachu Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from the chairman!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pikachu Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!
You got an [VAR COLOR(0006)]Eevee Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from the chairman!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Eevee Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!

It’s a costume set that you can use to dress up
like your partner Pokémon!\c
You can change via the Bag option in the
main menu!
Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!

Hello there, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
I hope you’re getting along with your partner!\c
Come back and see me once you’re best friends
with [VAR PKNICK(0003)]!
Oh ho! Your [VAR PKNICK(0003)]...\c\nI can see it’s just best friends with you!

This... This is the ultimate bond between
a Pokémon and a Trainer!\c
Thank you for showing me such
an amazing thing. Take this as thanks!
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Raichu Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from the chairman!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Raichu Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!

You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Vaporeon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)], [VAR COLOR(0006)]Jolteon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)],
[VAR COLOR(0006)]Flareon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)], [VAR COLOR(0006)]Espeon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)], [VAR COLOR(0006)]Umbreon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)],\c
[VAR COLOR(0006)]Leafeon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)], [VAR COLOR(0006)]Glaceon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)], and [VAR COLOR(0006)]Sylveon Set[VAR COLOR(0000)]
from the chairman!
You put all of them in your Clothing Trunk!
I can’t let me and my Pokémon fall behind now,\ncan I? Hohoho!

Hello, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\c
Did you come see me about my Pokémon again?\c
No?
Too bad!
